title: Cloned voice of a grandson asking for bail money
story: A call from an unknown number in what sounds exactly like her grandson's voice: he has been in an accident and needs ₹25,000 for the police right now, and she must not tell his parents.
why: First payment, 23× the customer's usual, during an 8-minute phone call from an unknown number. The payee looks clean (no flag yet), so only journey and context can carry this; a pause or trusted check is right, a hold may not be reachable without an outside flag.
